notes.title: GAMEPLAY CHANGES! COLORS! AND BUG FIXES!
notes.notes:
Colors!
Added color variants for villagers!
Healing changes!
Healing now costs 4 hp to cast, in turn, every map after the first one gives 3 rations to each villager!
Bug fixes!
Winged cavaliers reclassing on a flying tile now positions them to the nearest non flying tile available.

The combat forecast displays skill damage now.

Pillagers will attack when blocked from moving towards a village, they will also aggro if no more villages are available.

notes.title: Naming! Also bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Added Naming for units.

Fixed an issue where a sorcerer couldnt be killed.

Fixed an issue with the grid on one of the 3rd maps not displaying properly.

Fixed an issue with the King's Shield skill where it would sometimes not work properly on consecutive maps.

Fixed an issue where tabbing out of the class change screen would sometimes result in a softlock.

Fixed an issue where under specific circumstances, your selection in the class change menu or skills menu wouldnt commit properly.

notes.title: Demo hotfix - 03/07
notes.notes: A big bug fix! This update should make it so softlocks are not present to my knowledge due to a change in logic. Do let me know if you find any more in the disscusion forus though! I appreciate the community and how helpful you all have been! I wanna iron out all these kinks with the demo and I don't want to release the full version with any of these major bugs so thanks to all of you for your continuous support :D

notes.title: Demo hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with the hit and run skill not working correctly.



Fixed an issue where turns taken by your units wouldnt save on suspend.

notes.title: FINAL DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
Fixed Inconsitencies in class skills belonging to the berserker, royal knight, and wizard classes.



This will be the final update for the demo! I will now continue to work on the 1.0 release of the game. If more major bug reports come up I will fix those but ideally I will now just focus on the full game.



Thank you to everyone for your support and I hope you keep enjoying the Valiant Villagers demo!



Stay tuned for a release date and for features that will be in the full game!

notes.title: DEMO HOTFIX
notes.notes: Hello all! this is a quick hotfix after really digging for softlocks, I really hope I managed to find em all now. If any of you still have softlock issues do let me know! But according to testing it now should be smooth sailing. Apologies for the issues with the demo and thank you to everyone for your patience. I will continue to fix any bugs that arise, although let's hope there's no more gamebreaking ones! Thank you for your support and I hope you are all having fun playing :)

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 3
notes.notes:
You can now save and suspend your current run! Loading it will delete the save file as well as starting a new run. This is to prevent rigging by loading your save over and over.



Fixed the inspire buff not adding movement to allies.



Fixed academy insight ocurring outside of intended instances.



Fixed mounted unit promotions where the promo pool was smaller than intended.

notes.title: Valiant Villagers DEMO - UPDATE 2
notes.notes:
Added flags as map markers.

Fixed Bugs where inputs would stop working after certain actions.

Fixed Bugs related to Sage Wards.

Fixed Bugs related to pressing the confirm button during a units fade animation on death.

notes.title: Valiant Villagers - Demo Hotfix!
notes.notes: Hot fix related to a bug when carrying on the healing action with animations on with a controller, where it would on ocassion result in a soft lock.
